{{Quote|You are ordered to return to the Kathol Outback region and locate the New Republic ship ''FarStar''. Intelligence indicates that the ''FarStar'' means to pursue our fleet into the Void. This is according to my design. You are ordered to slow the enemy's progress through the Kathol Outback. This will provide ample time for the bulk of my fleet to complete preparations for the ''FarStar''{{'s}} eventual reception&mdash;and that of the New Republic regional fleet.|Extract from Kentor Sarne's mission orders to Captain Rolf Treidum|<ref name="ko" />}}
The '''''Lialic II''''' was a [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] in service to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Assigned to the [[Kathol Sector Imperial Fleet]], the ''Lialic II'' was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rolf Treidum]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector's]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]], [[Kentor Sarne]], withdrew his [[Sector/Legends|sector]] from the Empire. The ''Lialic II'' ended its service to the Empire and became part of Sarne's [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|liberated]] the Kathol sector [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]], forcing Sarne to flee into the [[Kathol Outback/Legends|Kathol Outback]]. The ''Lialic II'' was part of the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Starship/Legends|ships]] that accompanied Sarne on his retreat. After learning that the New Republic had tasked the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' to hunt him down, Sarne ordered Treidum to take the ''Lialic II'' on detached duty to slow their progress. Rechristening the ship as the '''''Lance of Endor''''', Treidum posed as a New Republic vessel and intimidated [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] throughout the Outback, turning public opinion against the New Republic and denying the ''FarStar'' potential allies.

During the course of its mission, Treidum used the ''Lialic II'' to turn the [[Kathol Republic]] against the ''FarStar'', [[Battle of Episol|destroying and damaging]] several of the Republic's [[Kathol Republic Navy|naval]] vessels and leaving the New Republic corvette to face the blame for the Imperial ship's actions. After several [[Standard month/Legends|months]], the ''Lialic II'' engaged the ''FarStar'' in direct [[Space warfare/Legends|combat]] during a [[Battle of Danoor|battle]] over the planet [[Danoor]]. Despite being supported by an [[Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer (Danoor)|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]], the ''Lialic II'' was destroyed during the battle when it was rammed by an [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] [[Sanhedrim ship]], which had responded to a call for help from the ''FarStar''{{'s}} allies, the [[Danoor Resistance]].

==Description==
The ''Lialic II'' was a [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]]. It measured 150 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] from bow to stern and had a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|Class 2 hyperdrive]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]], with a Class 10 backup. For armament, the ''Lialic II'' mounted six [[Turbolaser/Legends|double turbolaser]] [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]] for offensive and defensive actions. A crew of eighty-five manned the ''Lialic II'', but the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] could have been operated by sixty-five. The ship was also able to accommodate ninety passengers. Equipped with enough supplies to operate for a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] without resupply, the ''Lialic II'' had a cargo capacity of 2,500 [[Metric ton/Legends|metric ton]].<ref name="ko" /> The ship also had a [[Gamma-class assault shuttle/Legends|''Gamma''-class assault shuttle]] assigned to it.<ref name="w" />

==History==
===Empires and Warlords===
[[File:Treidum.jpg|right|thumb|Rolf Treidum, commander of the ''Lialic II'']]
The ''Lialic II'' was one of many CR90 [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]] in service to the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and was assigned to the [[Kathol Sector Imperial Fleet]]. Following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]], ruler of the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]], quietly withdrew his [[Sector/Legends|sector]] from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] and set himself up as a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]]. At that point, the ''Lialic II'' became part of the Moff's personal [[Moff Sarne's forces|military forces]] and was under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rolf Treidum]].<ref name="ko" />

By [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the ''Lialic II'' was equipped with old and outdated equipment and was scheduled to be refitted at a secret [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] in the [[Sorbiss Valley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]]. Work was due to begin on the vessel several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after work on converting another CR90 corvette, the [[FarStar|''Renegade'']], into a long-range exploration vessel and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] was completed. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] launched a [[DarkStryder Campaign|campaign]] against Sarne, however, and [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|liberated]] Kal'Shebbol from his rule. Instead of being refitted, the ''Lialic II'' escaped into the depths of the Kathol sector alongside the rest of Sarne's forces. The ''Renegade'' was subsequently captured by the New Republic, renamed as the ''FarStar'', and sent on a mission to track down Sarne and neutralize the threat he posed.<ref name="ko" />

===Playing felinx and rodus===
As Sarne's forces retreated from Kal'Shebbol, they traveled through the backwater [[Kathol Outback/Legends|Kathol Outback]] and beyond into the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]], an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] filled with dense [[Nebula/Legends|nebulae]] and dangerous [[lightstorm]]s. When Sarne learned that the ''FarStar'' was about to cross the [[Marcol Void/Legends|Marcol Void]]&mdash;an area of empty space thirty [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] across&mdash;the Moff issued orders to Treidum to detach from the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] and return to the Outback. Treidum's orders were to delay the progression of the ''FarStar'' through the Outback but not to stop them. Sarne intended for the ''FarStar'' to eventually catch up with him but planned to deal with them on a battlefield of his choosing. He needed [[Time/Legends|time]] to prepare, however, and tasked Treidum and the ''Lialic II'' with holding them at bay. Treidum was also to deny the ''FarStar''&mdash;and, by extension, the New Republic&mdash;any potential allies in the region. To achieve this, Treidum gave the ''Lialic II'' the alias ''Lance of Endor'' and posed as an emissary of the New Republic. Visiting several neutral planets in the Outback, he made outrageous demands in the name of the New Republic. When the planets refused to reply to the demands, Treidum used the weaponry of the ''Lialic II'' against the worlds in a show of force. This served to turn planets in the Outback against the ''FarStar'' in particular and the New Republic in general.<ref name="ko" />

===Baiting the ''FarStar''===
{{Quote|&hellip; will be pleased, Captain Treidum, with the results. I suspect your idea of &hellip; shall yield us handsome dividends. Pray continue to encourage the belief that &hellip; will be joining you in the Episol system shortly to observe your handiwork first-hand as planned.|Kentor Sarne, in a transmission to Rolf Treidum designed to be intercepted by the ''FarStar''|<ref name="le">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Little Empires|book=The Kathol Outback}}</ref>}}
Sarne ordered the ''Lialic II'' to the [[Kathol Republic]], a small collection of planets that had allied with one another for mutual [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] and defense purposes. He intended for Treidum to use the [[Kathol Republic Navy]] to cause serious problems for the ''FarStar''. To this end, Treidum took the corvette to the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Dayark]], in the [[Episol system]]. In a message to the [[Kathol Republic Senatorial Council|government]] of the Republic, Treidum demanded the annexation of all Kathol Republic worlds, a 50% tax on products and resources, the forced sterilization of all colonists, and the replacement of all elected officials with appointed New Republic representatives. Treidum subsequently intentionally broadcast his report on the matter to Sarne in a wide-beam transmission, luring the ''FarStar'' to the [[Star system/Legends|system]], since he knew that the New Republic crew would not pass up an opportunity to learn more about Sarne's location or plans.<ref name="le" />

[[File:BravadoIII-KatholOutback.jpg|thumb|left|The ''Bravado III'', following its battle with the ''Lialic II'']]
With the ''FarStar'' en route, the ''Lialic II'' returned to the Episol system. Treidum's previous demands were refused&mdash;as he had expected&mdash; and he then [[Battle of Episol|engaged]] two of the Republic's [[Marauder-class Assault Corvette/Legends|''Marauder''-class corvettes]] in battle. The brief skirmish resulted in the destruction of one corvette and severe damage to another, the ''[[Bravado III]]''. The battle was cut short when the ''FarStar'' entered the system, forcing the ''Lialic II'' to retreat to preserve the ruse. As intended, the Kathol Republic believed the ''FarStar'' to be in league with the ship they knew as the ''Lance of Endor'' and moved to attack them. The ''FarStar'' surrendered rather than fight and subsequently had to prove that the ''Lialic II'' was not affiliated with the New Republic at all, which they achieved by showing the Senatorial Council the transmission from Treidum that they had intercepted, which had led them to the Episol system in the first place.<ref name="le" />

Shortly after the ''Lialic II''{{'s}} actions at Episol, a [[Unidentified Gamma-class assault shuttle|''Gamma''-class assault shuttle]] assigned to the corvette was detached from the ship and ordered to rendezvous with agents of the [[Qektoth Confederation]], a militant order of [[Scientist/Legends|scientific]] idealists who believed in the superiority of organic technology. Sarne and the Confederation had entered into an agreement to trade bioweapons for ships and crews. The [[Assault shuttle/Legends|assault shuttle]] was later used by the Confederation as a testbed for a [[Qektoth Confederation biochemical agent|biochemical agent]] they were developing.<ref name="w" />

===Final mission===
{{Quote|Greetings. I am Captain Treidum of the New Republic vessel ''Lance of Endor''. We've come from the Galactic Core to eradicate your people.|Captain Rolf Treidum, posing as a New Republic emissary|<ref name="ge">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Galaxy's Edge|book=The Kathol Outback}}</ref>}}
The ''Lialic II'' later visited the planet [[Danoor]] on the edge of the Kathol Rift, where Treidum made several outrageous demands of the population in the name of the New Republic. However, despite posing as an emissary of the New Republic, Treidum made his true allegiance known to [[Minister]] [[Waric Nane]], whose [[Politics/Legends|political]] views paralleled Moff Sarne's. Nane was planning to take full control of Danoor and establish a hard-line despotic regime, and the two talked about a possible alliance between a Danoor ruled by a totalitarian government and Sarne's forces. Nane promised to consider the offer. As he left, Treidum gave Nane a device to allow him to contact the ''Lialic II''. The captain requested that the minister contact him if the New Republic should ever arrive at Danoor and that the minister was to delay their departure until Treidum and the ''Lialic II'' could arrive.<ref name="ge" />

[[File:Battleofdanoor.jpg|thumb|right|The Battle of Danoor]]
A [[Standard week/Legends|week]] later, Treidum's device was activated. With the ''FarStar'' at Danoor, Treidum ordered the ''Lialic II'' back to the system, accompanied by an [[Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer (Danoor)|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]]. Arriving in system, the ''Lialic II'' and the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Battle of Danoor|attacked]] the ''FarStar''. The New Republic ship was aided by starfighters from the [[Danoor Resistance]]&mdash;who were aware of Minister Nane's ambitions and were actively trying to stop him&mdash;and the space above Danoor was soon filled with light as the ships traded fire. In the middle of the [[Space warfare/Legends|fighting]], the Star Destroyer used a weapon called a [[devastator torpedo]] to destroy a ten-[[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] area of the planet. The Danoor Resistance ships disengaged from the battle to assist their fellow citizens.<ref name="ge" />

However, the arrival of a [[Sanhedrim ship]]&mdash;crewed by the mysterious [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] [[Species/Legends|species]], who had answered a request for help from the Resistance&mdash;turned the tide of the battle in favor of the ''FarStar''. The massive vessel headed straight for the ''Lialic II'', ramming the ship. The corvette was destroyed with all hands. With the ''Lialic II'' destroyed, fighters from the ''FarStar''{{'s}} [[FarStar starfighter squadron|starfighter squadron]] managed to destroy the Star Destroyer by placing precise [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] strikes on the launcher for the devastator torpedo. A chain reaction caused an explosion that engulfed the vessel, ending the battle.<ref name="ge" />

==Commanders and crew==
The ''Lialic II'' was commanded by Captain Rolf Treidum, a veteran [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] in the Imperial Navy. Treidum had served with Moff Kentor Sarne during the early phase of their careers, and was transferred to the Kathol Sector Imperial Fleet when Sarne was appointed to rule the Kathol sector in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. As commander of the ''Lialic II'', Treidum reveled in his role to delay the ''FarStar''{{'s}} advance through the Kathol Outback. His [[Rolf Treidum's son|son]] had been killed during the fighting at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] four years previously, and the officer was grimly aware of the irony in giving his vessel an alias that was linked to the death of his child.<ref name="ko" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Lialic II'' was introduced in ''[[The Kathol Outback]]'', the second [[Roleplaying game|RPG]] supplement for [[The DarkStryder Campaign (series)|''The DarkStryder Campaign'']], published by [[West End Games]] in [[1996]]. The ''Lialic II'' is the antagonist vessel for the ''FarStar'' in several adventures, as its actions usually set in motion a series of events that the crew has to deal with to continue their mission to find Moff Sarne. However, the vessel is not encountered by the ''FarStar'' directly until the last adventure in the book, ''[[Galaxy's Edge]]''.
